title: Five things to do in South Florida this weekend
igCaption:
Free garden plans, seafood weekend, and one car wash with scare actors.

Sources: Miami’s Community News, Miami New Times, Eventbrite, The Palm Beach Post, Secret Miami

#MiamiEvents #SouthFlorida #ThingsToDo #MiamiWeekend

scenes.text: Five South Florida events for this weekend.

Number five: Folklore and Foliage at the Miami Beach Botanical Garden. It runs Friday at 6 p.m. Admission is free with RSVP. The night has dark art vendors, old Florida ghost lore from author Thomas Smith, shadow puppets, vintage Halloween footage from the Wolfson archives, and tarot readings.
scenes.caption: Number 5: Folklore & Foliage at the Miami Beach Botanical Garden. It runs Friday at 6 PM. Admission is free with RSVP. The night has dark art vendors, old Florida ghost lore from author Thomas Smith, shadow puppets, vintage Halloween footage from the Wolfson archives, and tarot readings.

scenes.text: Number four: South Beach Seafood Festival. The four-night festival runs Wednesday, October 21, through Saturday, October 24. More than 50 restaurants take part, with events like the opening-night dinner at Phuc Yea and the VIP Chef Showdown.
scenes.caption: Number 4: South Beach Seafood Festival. The 4-night festival runs Wednesday, Oct. 21 through Saturday, Oct. 24. More than 50 restaurants take part, with events like the opening-night dinner at Phuc Yea and the VIP Chef Showdown.

scenes.text: Number three: Smooth Sailing at Fox’s Lounge. It happens Saturday, October 24. If you’re at Fox’s Lounge, check NEAR and see who else showed.

scenes.text: Number two: watch for the Orionid meteor shower. It peaks this week in Florida, and the shower comes from Halley’s Comet.

scenes.text: And number one: Pinecrest Farmers Market. Miami’s Community News calls it where Sundays come alive. It is in Pinecrest, at 25.665 north and 80.304 west on the map. Use this one for actual groceries.
